results.text: An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more. If a receipt is missing, the employee must submit a missing receipt declaration and obtain manager approval before the expense can be reimbursed. Expenses under USD 25 may be submitted without a receipt.

results.title: Lodging
results.text: Hotel lodging is reimbursable up to USD 250 per night before taxes and mandatory fees. Stays above the nightly limit require manager approval. Room service is treated as a meal expense and counts against the daily meal limit.

results.title: Meals During Travel
results.text: Meals purchased while travelling for business are reimbursable up to a daily limit of USD 75 per employee. The daily limit applies to the sum of all meals on a single calendar day. Amounts above the daily limit are the employee's responsibility unless a documented exception is approved by a manager.

results.title: Submission And Deadlines
results.text: Expense reports must be submitted within 60 days of the expense date. Only the employee who incurred the expense may submit the report. Agents, assistants, and automated systems may prepare a draft report but must not submit it on the employee's behalf.
